title: Skydiving with a christian baby
author: Claude_human_4271
selftext:
Atheists, imagine you're going skydiving with a christian baby.  
Suddenly the baby tells you he won't open his parachute until you renounce atheism and accept jesus as your lord and savior. What would you do?

The game.

comments.author: AssistBorn4589
comments.body:
Interesting idea.

Do I like him? Is he small enough for me to just grab him and either force parachute to open or just hold him?

How is game related to the question? Seems like I've lost but I have no idea why...

replies.author: Claude_human_4271
replies.body:
Basically the two of you are bound together and he's using christian magic to hold the parachute and only by incanting the sacred words may you release the parachute.

Also you should land as close to the bible as possible

replies.author: AssistBorn4589
replies.body: So it seems like, I have to write that phrase while also controlling the flyier. Honestly, I got that on 2nd attempt, but it's really not immediatelly clear at all. Plus, typing doesnt work at all on my browser, but I have enought extensions installed to kill half of the web, so that may be on me.

replies.author: Claude_human_4271
replies.body: I think it's bound to LMB too, yeah it's very much not clear :D it was just a one-shot meme game to get it off my chest, but I'm glad you gave it a try!

comments.author: -CaptainFormula-
comments.body:
"Renounce atheism" lol. Renounce a *lack* of belief.

Of course anyone would make a noise with their mouth if it saves the life of a baby. It's meaningless sounds.

replies.author: -CaptainFormula-
replies.body:
I agree. I can confidently say most, nay all, atheists I've known would say "uh, yeah I'm a christian now." To save a baby's life. I'd have to assume most any Christian would say "uh... god's not a real thing" If it meant saving a baby's life.

"Convert to my religion or I'll kill a baby!" Is at best a questionable message to sell your holy book.

replies.author: Claude_human_4271
replies.body:
Yeah, I think that was the point of the memes that I based the game on. Weird premises such as "atheists, imagine that you and a christian baby are running from a rolling boulder..." etc.  
It fits my style of humor so I thought it was worth chunking out a sloppy game, first time I had AI do 3D for me so I took it as an opportunity to try new things.
